title: Schedule of Dependent Coverage, Linden Memberships
content:
Under Linden Memberships, dependents are covered only on a tier whose schedule below allows them. For each tier the schedule states how many dependents the base dues cover, the monthly dues added for each dependent beyond that number, the most dependents one membership may carry, and the age at which a dependent leaves the family membership. On the annual cycle, the dues added for each such dependent are twelve times the monthly figure.

## Schedule

| Tier | Dependents covered by the base dues | Monthly dues per additional dependent (USD) | Most dependents on one membership | Age at which a dependent leaves (years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 (no dependents) |
| Linden Essential Membership | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 (no dependents) |
| Linden Family Membership | 4 | 39.00 | 6 | 26 |
| Linden Plus Membership | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 (no dependents) |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 (no dependents) |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 (no dependents) |

An age figure of 0 means the tier carries no dependents.

## Reading the schedule for the Linden Family Membership

- The base dues cover 4 dependents. The fifth and sixth dependents each add 39.00 to the monthly dues; on the annual cycle each adds twelve times 39.00, that is 468.00, to the annual dues.
- One membership carries at most 6 dependents; a seventh dependent cannot be added.
- A dependent leaves the family membership at age 26.

| Hypothetical number of dependents | Dependents beyond the 4 covered | Monthly add-on (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0 | 0.00 |
| 4 | 0 | 0.00 |
| 5 | 1 | 39.00 |
| 6 | 2 | 78.00 |
| 7 | not permitted (above 6) | not applicable |

## Other tiers

The Linden Connect Virtual Membership, Linden Essential Membership, Linden Plus Membership, Linden Premier Concierge Membership and Linden Executive Health Membership each cover the primary member alone: none of them includes or accepts a dependent.
